text:
emily: Quick planning thread — we need to lock facilitation & prework owners for the Annual Planning offsite (Apr 15-16). Can folks confirm availability and pick a facilitation slot they'd prefer by EOD Wed? Draft prep pack & agenda here: https://docs.google.com/example-offsite-prep  :spiral_calendar:

raj: Available both days. Happy to lead the Roadmap prioritization breakout.

sara: I can take OKR alignment (day 1 afternoon). Will add customer-facing metrics slides to the prep pack.

mike: Logistics lead — can own travel stipend / hotel block coordination. Need names by next Tue.

olivia: +1 for a dedicated "Customer Ask Triage" slot. Suggest adding a 60m panel with PMs + CS to vet asks. I can co-host that panel.

jess: I can prep 5 customer case studies for the triage panel — will upload to the doc by Thu.

amir: Quick note — we should add a short async rubric for scope negotiation (tradeoffs, rollback criteria). I can draft a 1-pager.

emily: Awesome. For facilitation slots:
```
- Day 1 AM: OKR framing (facilitator: sara)
- Day 1 PM: Roadmap prioritization (facilitator: raj)
- Day 2 AM: Customer Ask Triage + Panel (facilitators: olivia + jess)
- Day 2 PM: Launch criteria & rollouts (facilitator: amir)
```
If that's broadly ok I'll mark owners in the prep pack and assign action items.

raj: Works for me. For prioritization breakout, I'd like a short prework: each PM submits top 3 initiatives with 1-sentence impact and risk. Can we set a deadline?

emily: Yes — ask PMs to submit by Apr 3. I'll add a template to the prep pack.

mike: Travel stipend — please DM me your preferred arrival/departure and dietary needs. I'll post the hotel booking link when confirmed.

product-bot: Event created: "Annual Planning Offsite" Apr 15 09:00 — Apr 16 16:00. Invitees: product, eng, go-to-market. (calendar: https://calendar.example/event/12345)

olivia: One more ask — can we reserve 20m at the end of Day 2 for next steps + owners? Helps with roll-forward.

emily: Good call, added a 20m closeout slot. Also planning a 30m facilitator sync (optional) on Apr 10 for anyone running a session — quick tips and running order.

jess: I can host a 15m tech-run with PMs whose slides need screen-sharing checks on Apr 14.

amir: Uploaded the scope-negotiation draft to the prep pack (section: tooling & rollbacks). Link: https://docs.google.com/example-offsite-prep#scope-rubric

sara: I'll add the OKR scoring grid to the pack and tag reviewers.

emily: Thanks everyone. Action items I'll assign after this thread: finalize facilitator list, prework templates, customer case upload deadline Apr 3, facilitator sync Apr 10, tech-run Apr 14. If you haven't volunteered and want to, reply here. Otherwise I'll assume the slots above are confirmed. :thumbsup:
